name: metatrader-skills
description: Claude Code agent skills for MetaTrader/MQL5 development, platform automation, and trading research. Provides structured expertise for building Expert Advisors, managing MT4/MT5 platform operations, and conducting backtest-driven performance analysis.

plugins.name: mql5-development
plugins.description: End-to-end MQL5 Expert Advisor development: EA architecture (5-layer wiring, OnTick, IsNewBar), risk engine (position sizing, drawdown guards, prop firm rules), signal generation (SMC/ICT, indicators, multi-timeframe confluence), market regime detection (trend/range, volatility, session, news filters), and trade lifecycle management (trailing stops, breakeven, partial closes, pyramiding).

plugins.name: metatrader-platform
plugins.description: MetaTrader 4/5 platform operations, Python API integration, and HTTP API bridge usage. Covers terminal installation and configuration (Windows/macOS/Linux), SSL/certificate management, 2FA/TOTP setup, MetaTrader5 Python package workflows, mt5-httpapi bridge for REST-based account/symbol/trade data, and platform automation scripts.

plugins.name: metatrader-research
plugins.description: Backtesting methodology and trading performance analytics for MetaTrader strategies. Covers MT5 Strategy Tester configuration, walk-forward and Monte Carlo analysis, overfitting detection, performance metric computation (Sharpe, Calmar, Profit Factor, drawdown), Python-based pandas evaluation pipelines, imported HTML report parsing, and experiment tracking for EA variants.

plugins.name: mt5-httpapi
plugins.description: MetaTrader 5 trading via REST for a running mt5-httpapi bridge — market data, orders, positions, history, and server-side technical analysis.
